title: Files approaching the 1500-line cap
cluster_summary: No file breaches the cap. Under layout-§1 (layout.md:57,71), a file in the 1000-1500 band is compliant and on notice, and the band is dispositioned in the automated-tests watch list. The real trigger for acting is each repo's own watch-list disposition, which has fired or gone stale: AuraMaster RESULTS.md:112 says 1327 against an actual 1406, BankLedger RESULTS.md:103 says 1221 against 1427, and LootHistory RESULTS.md:103-104 records re-check triggers at 1400 and 1300 that have both been passed. The fix belongs in each repo and has no upstream route. Do one verbatim pure-move peel per hot file (AM Database migrations, BL Browser per-tab views, LH BrowserTable grouping layer) and refresh the stale watch-list rows and ARCHITECTURE census sentences in the same commit. Fold BL-A-06 into BL-R-02. The AM drag test split and the LH Browser.lua widget-kit peel are optional.

verdicts.assessment: core/Database.lua is 1406 lines (verified). It is in the compliant band, so there is no layout-§1 breach, but AuraMaster's own RESULTS.md:112 trigger ('if it grows further, the migrations are the seam to peel', recorded at 1327) has fired. Each schema step appends roughly 70-80 lines, so a breach is two steps away. Frozen migration bodies are a clean, low-risk verbatim-move seam.
verdicts.remediation: Pure verbatim move of MigrateV2..V12, their private helpers and the frozen id tables into core/Database_Migrations.lua, with the TOC line after core\Database.lua and a load-order comment. Keep SCHEMA_STEPS, climbLadder, NS.RunMigrations, EachProfile, AceDB init and registry helpers in core/Database.lua. Export only what the move needs (Database.NormalizeKeys, DeepCopy rebind) and rename nothing else. In the same commit, update the module-map.md and ARCHITECTURE load-order lines and any core/Database.lua:<line> citations the move breaks, and refresh the RESULTS.md:112 watch-list row.

verdicts.assessment: tests/test_anchors_drag.lua is 1490 lines (verified), compliant and 10 lines under the cap. It is maintainer-only, and nothing breaks until the next drag case lands. A split now is cheap but not required. Note that the tests/run.lua:82 citation is only the opening of the suites table; the suite entry is at :127.
verdicts.remediation: Either split along the drag-lifecycle vs drop/attach seam in the commit that would cross 1500, or do it in this sweep as a verbatim move: add the new suite to tests/run.lua, put the shared helpers in a helper module or duplicate them if there are fewer than two consumers, and regenerate docs/test-cases.md with the Total unchanged. Filing an issue that names the seam is also an acceptable terminal state.

verdicts.assessment: This is the same file and fact as BL-R-02, and the numbers are correct (1427 lines, +206 since 1221). Its named seam (skin/close factory plus geometry) is outdated, because B:ApplySkin already delegates to Core.ApplySkin, so that seam would move only about 100 lines. The growth is the per-tab view machinery. It is merged into BL-R-02.

modules/Browser.lua is 1427 lines (verified), compliant and in the band, so severity medium is overstated. Still, it grew 206 lines in about 10 days with 73 lines of headroom left, its tracked BL-24 seam was never cut, and the watch-list row (RESULTS.md:103, 1221) and the ARCHITECTURE census sentence (1328) are stale. This item absorbs BL-A-06.
verdicts.remediation: One pure-move peel of the per-tab view machinery into modules/Browser_Views.lua, with the TOC line after Browser.lua and a LOAD-ORDER comment. Do not also do the skin/geometry peel. In the same commit, update docs/module-map.md and the ARCHITECTURE load order and census 'largest file' sentence, refresh the RESULTS.md:103 BL-24 row and its named seam, and re-read standalone-windows register condition (3). There is no test-count change. Leave test_browser.lua and test_profiles.lua as they are (in band, not near the cap).

verdicts.assessment: modules/BrowserTable.lua is 1476 lines, 24 under the cap, and modules/Browser.lua is 1416 (both verified). LootHistory's own watch-list triggers (RESULTS.md:104 'Re-check at 1300', :103 'Re-check at 1400 ... peel the widget kit then') have both fired. Any non-trivial BrowserTable change breaches the cap. The ARCHITECTURE.md census sentence (1296) is also wrong.
verdicts.remediation: Required part: a verbatim pure-move peel of the BrowserTable.lua grouping/holder-move layer into modules/BrowserTableGroup.lua, loaded after its parent. Optional part: peel the Browser.lua widget kit into modules/BrowserWidgets.lua only if it is a clean verbatim move; otherwise reset its watch-list trigger (e.g. peel at 1450 or at the next feature). In the same commit, update module-map/ARCHITECTURE load order, the ARCHITECTURE.md:431 census 'largest file' sentence, and the RESULTS.md:103-104 rows. Sequence it after C-01.
